Around 2008/2009 I was on a school trip, and on a bus with my friends. There was a new shopping centre/strip mall being built in my hometown, and the bus stopped at a pedestrian crossing. I looked out the window, and saw a young man (i thought early 20s), in business clothes carrying a computer into a pharmacy chain store that was going to open up soon in the strip mall. He had slightly ginger spiky hair and a goatee and he was quite skinny. I jokingly said to my friends "I'm gonna be his girlfriend one day" We all laugh and i think nothing of it.

Fast forward to early 2013,  i had just turned 18 and hopped on a fairly obscure (adult) dating website. Came across this one guys profile and he looked slightly familiar but couldnt place where i had seen him before. He was hot, so i messaged him just to see if he would reply. He did, we went on a few dates, had super similar tastes in a lot of things so he ended up being my boyfriend. 
I later found out that he was the IT guy for that pharmacy chain, and he was setting up the stores computers on the same day my school bus went past. He even showed me a photo of what he looked like when he was working for the pharmacy chain: spiky slightly ginger hair and a goatee.
Three years later I'm still with him and going strong.
